search_text: published ZDI-24-833 ZDI-CAN-22418 (Pwn2Own) Synology BC500 synocam_param.cgi Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2024-07-11 CVE-2024-39349 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2024-39349 8.8 AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Synology'] ['BC500'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Synology BC500 cameras. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the synocam_param.cgi module. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Synology has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: (Pwn2Own) Synology BC500 synocam_param.cgi Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Synology BC500 cameras. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the synocam_param.cgi module. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
